d: Europe is on fire in 2026. From Serbia to France, Italy, Spain, Portugal and Belgium students, teachers, workers and ordinary people are flooding the streets. In Serbia a deadly railway station collapse sparked massive anti-corruption protests. Students forced President Vučić to resign and their new party “Students Win” stunned the nation in elections with record turnout. France exploded over crumbling schools, missing teachers, overcrowded classrooms and soaring fuel prices. Yellow Vest vibes returned riots, burning buildings, thousands arrested.
